law: Map every unique identifier Dualis may ever bind — unused fields stay null/dash, never invent. Dual positions via positions[] + primary pos.

fields.pos: primary position OR dual face string (LW/RW, C/LW, C/RW) — parser expands to positions[]
fields.positions: ordered dual/multi — e.g. ["LW","RW"] or ["C","LW"]; all F-bucket
fields.shot: L|R stick when cited — empty until cite

ids.teamsnap_player: TeamSnap player id on this team

fields.landing_prebaked: true when Me/Game packs exist offline for this seat

dual_forward_syntax.parse: split on / → positions[] ordered as written; pos = first token
dual_forward_syntax.pos_bucket: always F for any C|LW|RW combination
dual_forward_syntax.note: Uncommon but valid Dualis syntax — never invent; only when cited

wing_law: Prefer explicit LW · RW · LW/RW · C/LW · C/RW. Do not face "Winger"/"W" — too vague (everyone is a winger). Bare W only as legacy alias → expand if cite says which wing; else dash until explicit.
